Owner decisions of 2026-11-07 (coordinator's message) override the docs here: Free hosted at about 300 events a month (about 40 families) with signed receipts; Starter $29 is the recommended wedge plan for small schools and includes the compliance pack (itemised receipts for state programs, not built); Pro $79 (Rifo, Pricing Lab, daily reconcile, QuickBooks/Xero sync: all next); Witnessed renamed Audited at $149 (Trifold's countersignature, the auditor portal, the compliance pack and daily Stripe matching: all next); the bundle is Audited + Bookkeeper, about $349. "Witnessed by Trifold" remains only the name of the badge on a countersigned record (TRADEMARKS.md). The docs may be updated on the stacked docs branch.

From the docs, unchanged: `docs/business/pricing-strategy.md` §4 (Community $0 self-hosted with no limits; Starter 5,000 events / 1,000 credits / 5 seats; Pro 25,000 events, 5,000 credits, unlimited seats, up to 3 organizations; 25,000 events / 8,000 credits on the top tier; "No per-seat fees. No per-transaction fees. No surprise bills."; event limits soft on every plan, only Platform pays about $1 per 10,000; annual billing two months free, $290 / $790 / $1,490; Witness API 500 receipts a month free, then $0.03–0.05); §4b (non-profits and co-ops about half: $15 / $39 / $79 / ~$249; stacking with annual undecided); `docs/business/business-plan.md` §6 and §8 (about 7 events a family a month: 300 events ≈ 43 families).

Status: no hosted plan is built (business-plan §3, phase 1 in §7). Every price is an assumption to test, not a decision. Wording: "Get early access" (`docs/website/decisions.md`).
